facts.best_time: Friday and Saturday nights for live music on the pub and hall stages; Saturdays if you want a brewery tour (call ahead).
facts.good_to_know: Pub hours: Mon–Thu 5–10pm, Fri–Sat 11:30am–1:30am, Sun 11:30am–11pm. Lodging is available on-site at the St. George Hotel and the Inn at Weston Landing.
facts.how_to_get_there: 500 Welt St., Weston, MO 64098 — about 35 minutes’ drive north of downtown Kansas City and 20 minutes from Kansas City International Airport.
facts.one_liner: An Irish pub built inside the 1840s lagering cellars of the Weston Brewing Company, with house-brewed beer and live music.
facts.why_go: The Weston Brewing Company says it was founded in 1842 by German immigrant John Georgian, who dug cellars deep into the hillside to keep his lager cold, and it describes itself as one of the first lager breweries in the United States. Today O’Malley’s 1842 Pub fills those vaulted stone cellars, pouring O’Malley’s beers brewed on-site alongside live Irish music in the historic river town of Weston.
